main.description: A short-lived, single-use proof that the repository owner asked to sign in to a croft.click managed service. Written by the user's own client under the record key the service chose; contains no billing or personal data. Safe to delete once the handshake completes.

service.description: DID of the croft.click service this proof is for. Verifiers reject records naming any other service.

nonce.description: Random value issued by the service for this challenge. Single-use.

createdAt.description: When the client wrote the record.

expiresAt.description: When the challenge expires, copied from the service's challenge. Verifiers reject records past this time.
